column1: # KEYED BY NAME, NOT TAXID, ON PURPOSE.
# NCBI taxonomy IDs get merged, split and retired. Hardcoding them rots
# silently and a rotted taxid means a missed detection. Instead,
# scripts/resolve_watchlist.py reconciles every name against the local taxdump
# at build time and writes watchlist.resolved.tsv with taxids attached. Any
# name that does not resolve to exactly one node is a HARD ERROR - the pipeline
# refuses to run on an unresolved watchlist.
# This seed list covers organisms that appear on published notifiable-disease
# and high-consequence-pathogen lists. It is a STARTING POINT and must be
# reconciled against the authoritative list for your jurisdiction before
# operational use - see scripts/fetch_authoritative_lists.py and docs/watchlist.md.
#   name              scientific name as it appears in NCBI taxonomy
#   rank              expected taxonomic rank of the call
#   min_unique_reads  stage-2 override; blank = pack default
#   min_breadth       stage-2 override; blank = pack default
#   near_neighbours   ';'-separated taxa for competitive mapping (see notes)
#   notes             detection pitfalls specific to this taxon
#   source            authoritative list this entry derives from

column8: notes
Chromosome is near-identical to the B. cereus group. Species call REQUIRES pXO1/pXO2 plasmid marker coverage, not chromosomal breadth alone.
>97% chromosomal ANI to Y. pseudotuberculosis. Discriminate on pPCP1/pMT1 plasmids and pseudogene content.
F. novicida is environmental and frequently miscalled as tularensis. Subspecies (tularensis vs holarctica) matters clinically; needs targeted loci.
Brucella spp. are >99% ANI to each other - species-level calls from metagenomes are usually NOT defensible. Report to genus unless marker loci resolve.
See B. melitensis note. Also a vaccine strain (S19, RB51) source - check for vaccine-strain markers.
See B. melitensis note.
B. thailandensis is a common environmental soil organism and the main false-positive source.
A clonal deletion derivative of B. pseudomallei - cannot be separated by breadth alone; requires absence-of-region logic.
Obligate intracellular, low biomass. Expect few reads; weight marker genes over breadth.

column7: Mycobacterium bovis;Mycobacterium bovis BCG;Mycobacterium africanum;Mycobacterium canettii;Mycobacterium avium
column8: MTBC members are ~99.9% ANI. Report as "M. tuberculosis complex" unless lineage SNPs resolve. BCG vaccine strain is M. bovis-derived.
Non-toxigenic environmental V. cholerae is common. Toxigenicity requires ctxAB/tcpA coverage, not species call.
Serovar is the actionable unit, not species. Hand off to a dedicated serovar caller (sylph salmonella db is already on this box).
L. innocua is a frequent co-isolate; discriminate on the LIPI-1 island.
Water-system contaminant of reagents is plausible - check controls.
Toxigenicity is tox-gene dependent and phage-borne; species call is insufficient.
Commensal Neisseria in nasopharynx cross-map heavily. Capsule locus needed for serogroup.
Polyphyletic species. Actionable signal is the BoNT gene cluster, which also occurs in C. butyricum/baratii.
Obligate intracellular, low biomass.
Highly repetitive genome inflates depth CV; relax max_depth_cv.
Saprophytic L. biflexa is environmental; pathogenic clade assignment matters.
Zoonotic; overlaps the animal pack.
Shigella is genomically E. coli. Species-level separation from metagenomes is unreliable; use ipaH plus lineage markers.
Only pathotype is actionable (e.g. stx1/stx2/eae for STEC). Species presence is uninformative - gate reporting on virulence loci.
IS481 is multi-copy and shared with B. holmesii - a classic false-positive route.
Invasive disease is the notifiable event, not carriage.
H. haemolyticus is a commensal mimic; serotype b needs the cap locus.

column7: Vaccinia virus;Cowpox virus;Monkeypox virus;Camelpox virus;Ectromelia virus
column8: Orthopoxviruses are highly collinear. A variola call demands high breadth AND discriminating terminal-region content; vaccinia (vaccine/lab strain) is the dominant false-positive source. Escalate immediately on any credible hit.
Clade I vs II matters; requires breadth across variable regions.
Reston is non-pathogenic to humans - species resolution is essential, not optional.
See Zaire note.
Segmented; require both L and S segments.
New World arenaviruses; vaccine strain Candid#1 exists.
Segmented (L/M/S); require multiple segments. Overlaps animal pack.
Extremely high sequence diversity - low-identity thresholds needed or true positives are missed.
Overlaps animal pack (equine).

column8: Ubiquitous; laboratory and index-hopping contamination is the norm, not the exception. Control subtraction is mandatory.

column8: Overlaps animal pack (camelid).
Segmented and reassorting. Subtype (HA/NA) is the actionable unit - a species call is not enough. Route to a segment-aware subtyper; flag H5/H7 explicitly.
